answer: A river pilot license stops Sybils at the wharf gate. First, each agent stakes 300 tokens and registers one hardware-bound identity card. Second, it completes 20 supervised river crossings over 14 days, each signed by two established pilots. Third, it answers a pulse check every 6 hours, a fresh heartbeat proving the same machine is still awake. Forging 1,000 fake pilots costs 300,000 staked tokens, 20,000 crossings, and 4,000 pulse checks a day, and one missed heartbeat sinks the license. Like a ferry sailing only when its captain's pulse is on the manifest, no ghost crew boards twice.
